headers.title: Headers and constants
headers.text: The site as Referer on every picture (covers through /_next/image want it too); COVER_ATTR the image attribute that held a real address.

getPopular.title: Popular
getPopular.text: The home page's __NEXT_DATA__ pageProps: the first list of title-like objects (a title and a slug, id or address). The real list key must be checked.

getLatest.title: Latest
getLatest.text: The same page; the list whose key mentions latest, recent or update when there is one.

search.title: Search
search.text: /search?q=words and its pageProps list; the search path is a guess until tested.

getDetails.title: Title page
getDetails.text: The first pageProps object with a title and a description.

getChapterList.title: Chapters
getChapterList.text: The pageProps list whose items carry a chapter number; addresses built from the item's slug or id under the title's address. The site's chapter path must be checked.

getPageList.title: Pages
getPageList.text: The chapter page's pageProps list of pictures, else the tags under the reader.

helpers.title: Helpers
helpers.text: One request with the site as Referer, the __NEXT_DATA__ JSON of a page, searches of that JSON for lists and objects, the common entry fields, /_next/image unwrapping and absolute addresses.
